Samira_CSM: Thinking out loud — small perf pilot for HarborTrust: int8 quant + region-aware warm-pool routing. Target: ~20% p50 reduction and ~15% token savings before renewal. Worth a quick canary?
Eli_SE: Yes. Customer flagged hallucination sensitivity. Recommend 5% canary, auto-fallback to fp16, and capture 300 blind samples. Need seq-length histogram and p95 baseline first.
Noah_RE: Baseline quicks: median_seq=110, p75=200, p95 spikes at 15:00 UTC. Latencies p50=205ms, p95=680ms. Small slice: ```json
{"15":{"reqs":2100,"p50":300,"p95":720}}```
Eli_SE: Canary YAML draft:
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.05
model_variant: harbortrust-v2-int8
fallback: harbortrust-v2-fp16
collect_samples: true
abort_on_quality_delta_pct: 1.0
```
Samira_CSM: I'll get customer sign-off on prompts and promise rollback within 45m if issues.
deploy_bot: Starting canary harbortrust-v2-int8 -> 5% traffic at 3623456810. Dashboard: canary/3623456789.
deploy_bot: Canary update: 20m in, p50 down 18%, p95 down 12%, error rate steady. No regression alerts.
Eli_SE: Exported sample set to `/shared/harbortrust/3623456789_samples.json` and queued blind eval (300). Will abort if >1% quality delta.
Samira_CSM: Great — if clean for 24h we'll include the optimization in renewal proposal. I'll draft the one-pager and share sample outputs with the customer once eval completes.
__notes: Compact CS+Eng Slack thread coordinating a conservative int8 quant + routing canary for an upcoming renewal. Includes a small YAML snippet and deploy bot updates.
